urls.rationale: Title 21 Ch. 8 Subch. 1 (General Provisions) supplies definitions used by the lobbying-disclosure subchapters.
Title 21 Ch. 8 Subch. 4 (Disclosure by Lobbyists and State and Local Officials — General Provisions) is the substantive lobbyist-disclosure regime.
Title 21 Ch. 8 Subch. 5 (Investigation by Attorney General) is the enforcement provision cross-referenced from Subch. 4 and 6.
Title 21 Ch. 8 Subch. 6 (Disclosure by Lobbyists) is the dedicated lobbyist-disclosure subchapter.

notes: Title 21 Ch. 8 exposed 10 subchapters; selected the four (Subch. 1, 4, 5, 6) that together house lobbyist registration + disclosure + enforcement. Subch. 2/3/7/8/9/10 are financial-interest / conflict-of-interest / ethics-code provisions for officials, not lobbyists per se.
